question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

785 - 125 + 12 ÷ 6 × 39 = 574
solution: Here, we use the BODMAS table given below: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] Given: ⇒ 785 - 125 + 12 ÷ 6 × 39 = 574 (1) × and + ⇒ 785 - 125 + 12 ÷ 6 × 39 = 574 After changing the signs: ⇒ 785 - 125 × __**12 ÷ 6**__ + 39 Apply BODMAS rule: ⇒ 785 - __**125 **____**× 2**__ + 39 ⇒ 785 - 250 + 39
